_readme.purpose: Source-backed data on the official AMD exchange rate (Central Bank of Armenia) and on the fees and FX margins of the largest Armenian banks and money transfer services for transfers between AMD, USD, EUR and RUB.
_readme.notes: docs/fx-and-fees-notes.md explains the data in plain words, with comparison tables and how often each value changes.
_readme.value_format: Sourced values like src/data/salary-tax.json and car-customs.json: value, unit, effective_from, source_url, source_name, evidence (original-language quote), evidence_en, last_verified, likely_change, conflict, unsure. Fee rows: percent / min / max / fixed / tiers in fee_currency (almost always AMD); percent applies to the transfer amount.
rules: No value was written from memory. Every number was read on 2026-10-26 from the official page or PDF in source_url; copies of every source are kept outside the project (research folder).

Only official provider sites were used for fees and rates. Where the official site was unreadable (Inecobank: bot check) or a fee is not published, the value is null with null_reason. Third-party aggregators were not used.
evidence_verbatim=false means the quote was stitched from table cells; the numbers were checked against the saved source, the wording is not a verbatim copy.
robots.txt was checked on each site; no disallowed path was requested directly. See _open_questions for one borderline case (ACBA rates page).
Bank buy/sell rates and margins are a single evening snapshot (about 22:00 Yerevan time, after business hours). They show the typical size of the margin, not a rate to use.
_readme.warning: ADVISORY DATA. Banks also pass on correspondent/intermediary bank charges that are not published. Always check the provider before sending money.

what.value: Average AMD exchange rates formed on the currency markets, published by the CBA
what.evidence: ՀՀ կենտրոնական բանկը վարում է ազատ լողացող փոխարժեքի քաղաքականություն ... Շուկայում ձևավորված փոխարժեքների հիման վրա Կենտրոնական բանկը հրապարակում է արտարժույթի նկատմամբ հայկական դրամի` արժութային շուկաներում ձևավորված միջին փոխարժեքները:
what.evidence_en: The CBA runs a free-floating exchange rate; based on market rates it publishes the average AMD rates formed on the currency markets.

operations.ExchangeRatesLatest: all rates of the latest published date; CBA: recommended for web-site integration
operations.ExchangeRatesLatestByISO: latest rate for one ISO code
operations.ExchangeRatesByDate: all rates for a date (param date, e.g. 2026-10-26)
operations.ExchangeRatesByDateByISO: one ISO code for a date

value.response_fields: CurrentDate, PreviousAvailableDate, NextAvailableDate, Rates[ExchangeRate{ISO, Amount, Rate, Difference}]
value.request_example: POST https://api.cba.am/exchangerates.asmx, Content-Type: text/xml; charset=utf-8, SOAPAction: "http://www.cba.am/ExchangeRatesLatest", body: <soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soap:Body><ExchangeRatesLatest xmlns="http://www.cba.am/" /></soap:Body></soap:Envelope>

api.source_name: CBA, «Փոխարժեքների ստացում» (How to get exchange rates via SOAP), 18/03/2011, linked from every cba.am page
api.evidence: Ստորև նկարագրված ֆունկցիաները հնարավորություն են ընձեռում SOAP-ի միջոցով ստանալ ՀՀ ԿԲ կողմից հրապարակվող փոխարժեքների վերաբերյալ տեղեկատվություն, ինչպես նաև ինտեգրել համացանցին միացված համակարգերում: ... ExchangeRatesLatest ... (խորհուրդ է տրվում վեբ կայքերում ինտեգրման համար)
api.evidence_en: The functions let you receive CBA exchange rates via SOAP and integrate them into internet-connected systems; ExchangeRatesLatest is recommended for web-site integration.

cross_checks.note: Called on 2026-10-26 (ExchangeRatesLatest, ExchangeRatesByDate, ExchangeRatesByDateByISO): works without a key, returns XML.

browser_access.evidence: OPTIONS/POST responses carry no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header; fetch() from a page on another origin in Chromium failed ("Failed to fetch").
browser_access.evidence_en: The API cannot be called from the visitor's browser on a static site (no CORS). Fetch it at build time (or with a scheduled job) and save the result into src/data, then serve it as a static file.

terms_of_use.source_name: cba.am (searched home, footer, SOAP page, robots.txt)
terms_of_use.evidence_en: No terms-of-use or licence page for the website or the API was found; robots.txt on www.cba.am and api.cba.am returned empty. The CBA itself publishes the API and recommends it for web-site integration, so using it is clearly intended. Credit the CBA as the source and cache results; do not poll it more than needed.
terms_of_use.unsure_reason: Absence of terms is not a licence; ask the CBA (feedback form) before heavy or commercial use.
terms_of_use.null_reason: No published terms of use found on cba.am or api.cba.am.

publication_schedule.value: Business days only; the response gives PreviousAvailableDate/NextAvailableDate. On 2026-10-26 (Monday) PreviousAvailableDate was 2026-10-23 (Friday): no rates on the weekend.
publication_schedule.evidence_en: Rates exist only for business days; for a weekend or holiday use the last published date.
publication_schedule.likely_change: Every business day (no new rate on weekends/holidays; the last published rate stays in force).
publication_schedule.unsure_reason: The time of day the CBA publishes the new rate was not found in an official text.

quote_units.evidence_en: Most rates are AMD per 1 unit, but JPY, KZT and UZS are per 10 and IRR per 100: always divide by the Amount field.

snapshot.likely_change: Every business day (no new rate on weekends/holidays; the last published rate stays in force).
snapshot.note: Snapshot for the margins below only. Do not use as a live rate.

_conflicts.detail: Converse lists a "CBA rate" of USD 361.14 / EUR 404.33 / RUB 4.49 on 26.10.2026; that is the CBA rate of 23.10.2026. The CBA API gives 360.88 / 404.11 / 4.4762 for 26.10.2026. Bank pages can lag: take the CBA rate only from the CBA.

_open_questions: Inecobank (rank 5 by assets): every official page returned a Cloudflare bot check (HTTP 403). All its values are null. Needs a manual look in a normal browser.

ACBA rates: read once by opening the public rates page in a browser. That page loads its numbers from /api/, which acba.am robots.txt disallows for crawlers. No /api/ URL was requested directly, but if strict compliance is wanted, drop banks[acba].conversion.rates_observed. Never fetch them automatically.

Wise: its terms forbid robots that monitor or copy the site, so its price API and calculator were not used. The two fee examples come from one read of the public send-money pages. Do not fetch Wise automatically.
MoneyGram and Remitly: serve Armenia, but fees load only in the browser and their terms forbid automated access. Fees null.
Western Union: Armenia is not offered as an online destination on the US, UK and FR sites, and WU stopped transfers in Russia in March 2022. Sending cash from agent locations was not checked.

KoronaPay: koronapay.com shows only a licence-withdrawal notice; the Russian site was not reachable and its robots.txt disallows the tariff calculator. Status for Armenia unknown (a non-official article of 24.07.2026 says transfers to Armenia stopped).
Unistream: the site uses a certificate from a Russian root CA that the browser does not trust; it was read with certificate checks off. USD/EUR payout rates returned a calculator error.
Correspondent and intermediary bank charges (SHA/BEN deductions) are not published by any bank.

Incoming international transfers: several banks have no explicit fee row (Ardshinbank, ACBA, Converse) or only a generic "crediting to account: free" row (Ameriabank, Evocabank, IDBank). Those rows are null or unsure.
The CBA publication time of day and any terms of use for api.cba.am were not found in an official text.
Bank rates were captured about 22:00 Yerevan time, after business hours. Margins during the day may differ.
